Government of the People's Republic of B: This document is issued under the authority of the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the issuing authority for this notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division acts as the administrative wing responsible for customs and value-added tax matters.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the regulatory body overseeing customs and value-added tax administration as referenced in the document's metadata header.
